limits: Static trace only: no captured instruction was executed and no concrete input values were observed.  The classified access census classifies each instruction of the three callee bodies by operand position in fresh objdump text (a mov-family bracket destination is a store, a bracket source is a load, a lea bracket is an address-taken); register identity follows the entry assignments (r14 = rdi in 0x4784130, rbx/r14/r15 = rdi/rsi/rdx in 0x2d4d540 until the lea at 0x2d4d5e7 rebinds r15 to rsi + 0x48, rbx/r14 = rdi/rsi in 0x5cf9600) and, for 0x5cf9600, the r14 census is split at the first r14 reload (0x5cf9bc6) and the rbx store sites are enumerated by address because rbx is reloaded on later arms.  Whole-record copies move bytes without naming fields -- the copies observed are enumerated in the findings (the spawns' struct copies, the head copy, the callee's [0x78..0x128) copy) -- so for copied fields the census is a statement about direct accesses and the copies actually observed.  The handler-table census verifies every candidate reference by re-disassembling its containing FDE from its start; raw byte-pattern hits that do not survive that check are recorded as phantoms, not references.  Jump-table arm reachability is recorded where the earlier packets recorded it and is not re-decided here.  Raw values are recorded mechanically; no field types are guessed.
